title: Yacht: multi-phase dice game with scoring categories
description: Pure dice game. Each turn: roll 5d6, optionally keep some and re-roll (up to 2 re-rolls), then assign result to one of 13 scoring categories (ones through sixes, three/four of a kind, full house, small/large straight, yahtzee, chance). Game ends when all categories filled. Validates: dice as components, multi-phase turns (roll/keep/re-roll/assign), constrained choice (unused categories only), counter-based scoring per category, game end when all slots filled. The definitive dice game.
close_reason: Yacht playable with 21 tests. Covers: 13 scoring categories (independent oracle functions), turn flow (roll/keep/re-roll), 2-reroll limit, category assignment, turn alternation, single-use categories, game end after 26 assignments, winner by total score, upper section bonus (35 pts at 63+).
